digest.component_or_area: test suite - store/CLI read concurrency regressions
propositions: Fault-seeded matrix shows the generic reads-under-sync-contention property misses shape-valid content-incomplete records (F3: empty JSON object; F6: missing ticket_id), which the original CLI regression test uniquely detects

The original test also detects failures the generic property catches, but the generic property detects stalls (F5) and list-surface failures (F7) that the original test misses, proving neither subsumes the other

Reverting the actual slim-fetch-ledge fix (original regression) leaves both burst/storm tests green; only the deterministic held-lock tests detect it, indicating storm tests are unreliable oracles for that specific race
Measured wall-clock timings place CI cost at ~57.6s per change across 4 jobs, but no runner savings are available from deletion because it forfeits the unique F3/F6 partial-success detection class
Standard mutation-testing criterion (Just et al. FSE 2014) licenses removal only when it does not decrease fault-detection score; here removal decreases score by losing F3/F6 coverage
